name: Kristy Socorro Rowe
office: El Monte Union High School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Kristy Socorro Rowe is a special education advocate. In a 2026 election questionnaire, Rowe said her top concerns are transparency and student support, and she pledged to be accessible to students, parents, staff, and administration. She stated she would use her knowledge of the education system to support teachers and students.
